change_title: Addition of UNSPSC Commodity Taxonomy to Item Templates
impact_assessment: Expands item category taxonomy from 4 generic categories to 6 UNSPSC-aligned categories to support granular spend reporting.

change_title: Scope Expansion: Strategic Sourcing RFx Module Inclusion
impact_assessment: Request to include multi-tier supplier bidding and automated quotation comparison in Phase 1 scope. Evaluated as non-viable within 14-week timeline.

change_title: Extension of Mock Cutover 2 Duration for Full Reconciliation
impact_assessment: Request to expand Mock Cutover 2 execution from 24 hours to 48 hours over a weekend to mirror actual production conditions.

change_title: Implementation of Secondary Managerial Approval for Manual Overrides > $250
impact_assessment: Introduces secondary approval requirement before an AP Supervisor can override an invoice price hold exceeding $250 to satisfy SOX controls.

change_title: Temporary Funding for AP Backfill Resource During UAT
impact_assessment: Funding for 3 weeks of temporary accounting contractor to backfill AP Lead's daily voucher entry during full-time UAT sessions.
